zh.d:
本版是品牌与能力的一次全面升级：dream 引擎更强——超长上下文静默失常时自动压缩并重试、非标准 finish_reason 不再丢工具调用，默认上下文窗口对齐 500k；内置模型扫码登录修复，一次扫码即可登录，真正开箱即用。新能力上，外网访问隧道让你出门也能用手机访问自己的电脑，浏览器视图升级为全局宿主，AutoCAD 图纸可转成可旋转的三维模型。

【新增】
· 【外网访问隧道】手机在局域网之外也能访问自己电脑上的 One Work：一键生成临时公网链接，远程连接页里固定地址与临时链接并排展示，出门在外接着用
· 【智能体浏览器】浏览器视图升级为全局宿主：智能体使用浏览器时自动打开面板（此前必须先手动开面板，否则报「未挂载」），开合面板不再重载页面；浏览器出现时预览区自适应加宽，标题栏新增常驻的彩色浏览器按钮
· 【AutoCAD 图纸】CAD 三维文件与带标注的型线图可转成可旋转的 3D 模型；技能新增零依赖的 read 读图命令（--texts 列出图中文字）与 preview 出图命令（出图不再写进技能目录），技能广场介绍同步更新
· 【任务通知】任务完成后自动推送到「我的聊天」：长任务收工即知，在设置页绑定你的飞书/Lark 机器人即可
· 【远程连接】远程连接页重做为总览主卡 + 分类卡片：外网访问的固定地址与临时公网链接并排；手机端新增导出管控与通知授权提示
· 【形象】新增共享场景与数字员工头像，智能体形象更丰富

【优化改进】
· 【上下文】长会话更稳：模型在超长上下文下静默失常时自动压缩并重试；无回复且上下文很大时明确提示手动压缩；默认上下文窗口对齐 500k；新增「上下文已压缩」「疑似超出上限」两种提示（13 种语言）

【修复】
· 【内置模型】修复扫码登录每次都失败：登录页提交的字段名与接口不一致，现在一次扫码即可登录
· 【智能体】修复「主导只宣布不派活」：供应商返回非标准 finish_reason 时不再静默丢弃工具调用
· 【预览】修复 HTML 预览超过约 2 MiB 时整页空白，改为空白页加脚本写入
· 【文件】「打开所在目录」对目录改为打开目录本身；Windows 上打开文件时会选中该文件
· 【技能】读图任务设了完成标准，不再被「必读/必写经验库」拖成几十步；model3d 对平铺的二维工程图（如总布置图）如实提示，不再冒充 3D

本版企业侧共享两项后端能力，同时同步单机版的全部引擎与会话修复。

【新增】
· 【模型渠道】渠道健康检查返回上游可用模型列表：编辑渠道时服务端直接拉取模型清单，不必手填

【优化改进】
· 【上下文】超长上下文静默失常时自动压缩并重试；无回复且上下文很大时明确提示手动压缩；默认上下文窗口对齐 500k（与企业单机版一致）

【修复】
· 【节点】运行时节点心跳上报本机已装 Agent：节点资产信息不再缺失
· 【内置模型】扫码登录页提交的字段名与接口不一致导致每次失败，已修复
· 【智能体】供应商返回非标准 finish_reason 时不再静默丢弃工具调用
· 【技能】读图任务设了完成标准，不再被拖成几十步；「打开所在目录」对目录改为打开目录本身

en.d:
This release upgrades the product and the engine together: the dream engine is stronger - contexts that silently misbehave when too long are auto-compacted and retried, non-standard finish_reason no longer drops tool calls, and the default context window is aligned to 500k; built-in model QR login is fixed, so a single scan logs you in and it truly works out of the box. New on top: an external access tunnel so your phone can reach your computer from outside the LAN, the browser view promoted to a global host, and AutoCAD drawings that convert into rotatable 3D models.

[New]
· External access tunnel: reach One Work on your own computer from outside the LAN - generate a temporary public link with one click; the remote access page shows the fixed address and the temporary link side by side, so you can pick up where you left off while away
· Agent browser: the browser view is now a global host - agents open the panel automatically when they use the browser (previously you had to open it manually first or hit an "unmounted" error), and opening/closing the panel no longer reloads the page; the preview area widens adaptively when a browser appears, and the title bar gains an always-visible colorful browser button
· AutoCAD drawings: CAD 3D files and annotated contour drawings convert into rotatable 3D models; the skill gains a zero-dependency read command (--texts lists all text in the drawing) and a preview command (rendered images no longer written into the skill directory); the skill gallery description is updated to match
· Task notifications: tasks now push a completion message to "My Chats" when they finish - bind your Feishu/Lark bot on the settings page and never wonder whether a long task ended
· Remote access: the page is redesigned as an overview card plus grouped cards - fixed address and temporary public link side by side; mobile gains export controls and notification permission prompts
· Avatars: new shared scenes and digital employee portraits make agent identities richer

[Improved]
· Context: long sessions are steadier - when a model silently misbehaves over a very long context, the context is auto-compacted and the turn retried; when there is no reply and the context is huge, you are clearly told to compact manually; the default context window is aligned to 500k; two new notices, "context compacted" and "suspected over limit" (13 languages)

[Fixed]
· Built-in model: QR login failed every time because the login page submitted field names the API did not accept - one scan now logs you in
· Agents: tool calls are no longer silently dropped when a provider returns a non-standard finish_reason - fixes "the lead only announces and never dispatches"
· Preview: HTML previews larger than about 2 MiB rendered a blank page - they are now served as an empty page written by script
· Files: "Open containing folder" opens the folder itself when the target is a folder; on Windows, opening a file selects it in Explorer
· Skills: drawing-reading tasks now have a completion bar and are no longer stretched into dozens of steps by "must-read/must-write experience library"; model3d honestly flags flat 2D engineering drawings (such as general-arrangement drawings) instead of pretending they are 3D

Two backend capabilities land on the enterprise side this release, and all engine and session fixes from the personal edition are included.

[New]
· Model channels: channel health checks now return the upstream model list - the server pulls the model catalog when you edit a channel, so you no longer type model names by hand

[Improved]
· Context: auto-compact and retry when a model silently misbehaves over a very long context; a clear manual-compact prompt when there is no reply on a huge context; default context window aligned to 500k (matching the personal edition)

[Fixed]
· Nodes: runtime node heartbeats now report locally installed agents, so node asset information is no longer missing
· Built-in model: the QR login page submitted field names the API did not accept and failed every time - fixed
· Agents: tool calls are no longer silently dropped when a provider returns a non-standard finish_reason
· Skills: drawing-reading tasks now have a completion bar and are no longer stretched into dozens of steps; "Open containing folder" opens the folder itself for folders
